invariants.rationale: Method always returns a constructed HoodieJavaTable instance for supported table types.
Only COPY_ON_WRITE and MERGE_ON_READ table types are supported; others result in an exception.
Constructors for HoodieJavaCopyOnWriteTable and HoodieJavaMergeOnReadTable pass metaClient as a parameter and likely set it as a member.
Constructors to HoodieJavaTable subclasses receive config and likely set it as a member.
Constructors to HoodieJavaTable subclasses receive context and likely set it as a member.
